# crosswork_aaa_sso_services (Data Source)

This data source can read the SSO service providers used for identity federation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_aaa_sso_services" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `services` (Attributes List) SSO service providers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `evaluation_order` (Number) Order in which the service providers are evaluated
- `metadata` (String) SAML metadata XML of the service provider, base64 encoded
- `metadata_location` (String) File name of the metadata
- `name` (String) Name of the service provider, letters and digits only
